notes.title: Alpha 1.1 Update: Steam Workshop now live!
notes.content:
We've been busy at work updating Esport Tactics and proud to release our Alpha 1.1 Update!

Now with our latest update you can create your own custom "player lists" of players that appear in the game! [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3226469462]Make sure you look at this guide before you work with the modding tool[/url] After you read the guide you can check the workshop item "Alpha 1.1 Player List" for an example you can download it and make your own player list out of it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42511847/5b9bcc7038a697c9cefe1065ede7a5c718315edf.png[/img]

Player lists are just the first mod feature, we plan on adding more in the future such as language packs or gameplay alterations. You can find all your player lists when creating a new franchise

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42511847/ba6a56fd05fd8dc4a48d0f1613279b9d9df16000.png[/img]

We also have multiple new achievements to go after. This should keep everyone busy while we work on more updates!

As always, report any bugs to our discord or pinned Steam discussion board post. Our discord join link and roadmap are linked below.

Thanks,

notes.title: NEWS: Spring Update, Preparing new features, fixing bugs
notes.content:
We've been working hard on some recent developments on Esport Tactics the past few months!

I started early preparations for Steam Workshop functionality. It was figured I wanted steam workshop to be a feature in the future, so I've prepared the first feature in development: Player databases! 

With this feature you can create a simple text file of a player database for who will be available in Esport Tactics franchise. The code for loading a custom file of the player list is finished but steam workshop integration will take more time and maybe not available at early access launch.

This custom player database will be great for anyone who wants to add real Esport players, themselves, or their friends and family to the game. This will also be good for non-english speakers who want players in their native language or country. 

We will create a guide on how to create a proper player database file when we launch the feature.

Other features we added included finishing our sponsor list and adding a player move speed option as some suggested the players moved too slow. So you can speed up turns much easier now.

Unfortunately I also ran into a few bugs I still have to fix before Esport Tactics is ready for launch. We also need to extend the standard database a bit more to give a bit of variety.

Don't worry, we're almost done with the Early Access version. 

As always please join the [url=discord.gg/RWRAWerzy5]Discord[/url] for closer communication.

Note: we have shut down the playtest as no new bugs have been discovered. You'll have to wait for the release to play more.

As always, our discord and roadmap are linked below.

Thank you all,
2 Turn Studios

notes.title: Good news everyone! Updates about Esport Tactics
notes.content:
Hello all,

We have good news coming to Esport Tactics, a lot has happened since the playtest launched. And we are approaching a release date.

[b]The elephant in the room[/b]

As most gamers have seen, back in September the Unity3D CEO announced that the company would be changing their fee system to where every game sale unity would take a cut. A deeper look into it had some developers speculating there could be a charge to every download or install of a game, not to mention this could effect free games or potentially demos. This decision could have made Esport Tactics unfeasible.

[b]Unity's reversal[/b]

Later the decision was reversed, but I did not see the reversal until [i]today[/i] because the damage was already done and the reversal was quietly send out on their blog. [b]This means Esport Tactics is back on the development trail![/b]

[b]State of playtest and Early Access release date[/b]

I'm proud to announce we are approaching Early Access, I wanted to take some time as gamers played the playtest and reported bugs. There have been no bugs issued since our last playtest update in June, so we are asking players to please submit any remaining bugs in our [url=https://discord.gg/RWRAWerzy5]Discord server[/url] under the bug-reports channel, or the Esport Tactics Playtest Steam Discussion "Playtest bug reporting"

Once we fix any newly reported bugs, or if a set amount of time passes without getting new bug reports, we will announce our release date. The playtest will then end and it will no longer be accessible. Goal is by end of 2023 as I planned originally.

As for when new features will be added throughout the Early Access phase, I am not sure on the timeframe but be assured the game will be worked on periodically and Discord is the best place to get quick information about Esport Tactics progress or ask me questions.

Lastly I would like to apologize for the lack of communication on progress for Esport Tactics. I am currently working 2 jobs and finding time to manage this project and when the Unity fee news hit I almost abandoned the game, but I did not. I decided to wait to see if Unity would reverse course, and they did. So Esport Tactics is on track for a release again :D

Thank you all so much for understanding, I hope you all look forward to Esport Tactics
-2 Turn Studios

notes.title: Open Playtest incoming! Postseason features created: State of the Game #3
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we'd like to update everyone on progress we've made on Esport tactics.

[h2]Open Playtest![/h2]

We're excited to announce we are planning on launching an Open Playtest for anyone who wants to try out Esport Tactics before we hit Early Access. It is planned for sometime in December. You will be able to request access through the Esport Tactics Store page.

The playtest will get regular updates on bug fixes so please report any bugs in our discord or on our pinned post on the steam discussion forum. The playtest will end once we launch in Early Access early next year. We apologize for not having Esport Tactics ready for launch in 2022 like originally planned.

[h3]Postseason screen[/h3]

Here is a sneak peak at our postseason screen, currently you can spend money and reputation on scouting for a youth player. The more you invest into your scout the better player you get, but if you don't invest enough you won't scout anyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42511847/d3eb77192fa3ca613ae3dd53624171da3813988e.png[/img]

[h3]We added yellow highlighting to players that are yours in the rankings list for easier viewing[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42511847/6b77a863166df20a8fad1665d93f242ecad4afa0.png[/img]

[h2]Additional Updates[/h2]

[list]
[*]Now when a player contract is up, a player retires or there is an important alert you have to resolve  that before going to management screen after a match
[*]Started adding career kills and career deaths to match stat compiler, so the game will track both season stats and career stats
[*]You can now view the enemy team's entire roster before a match
[*]New title screen!
[*]Cleaner, more scalable code for match stat compiler
[*]Added ability to go to the title screen from the management menu
[*]Created postseason feature: scouting
[*]After postseason player continues on to the next season
[/list]

Join our discord, follow us on twitch, or view our roadmap on the links below

notes.title: Esport Tactics Dev Progress Updates
notes.content:
We would like to apologize for the lack of updates on our Steam page, we have had many unexpected hurdles with our team in the last few months but now can update everyone on the state of the game. As always our [url=https://discord.gg/RWRAWerzy5]Discord[/url] is the best method of communication with us, and you can see our roadmap plans [url=https://trello.com/b/RuzRnJrd/esport-tactics-roadmap#]here[/url] and watch our dev streams [url=twitch.tv/2turnstudios]on Twitch[/url] 

There has been a TON of progress on Esport Tactics in the last couple of months, including the following new features:

-2 new teams in your starting league, bringing it up to 8 total (including yours)
-New music!
-Updated contract system
-Dozens of players added
-Simulate game option
-Steam Achievements!
-Player retirement feature
-A robust help menu (see part of it below)
-Countless bug fixes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42511847/54f21f10f6424f383fc7b9c4c567e129f5828f5b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42511847/e83ffe6214aea147fb65fae53dd758a98581cc65.png[/img]

We still hope to have our early access launch ready by the end of the year but it might be delayed until slightly after. If the release has to be delayed we will at least try to get an open beta by the end of the year.

Thank you to all,
